changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER ticket_inventory_assign_manual_code BEFORE INSERT ON ticket_inventory_ticket FOR EACH ROW WHEN (NEW.manual_code IS NULL) EXECUTE FUNCTION assign_ticket_inventory_manual_code();
ALTER TABLE ticket_inventory_ticket ADD CONSTRAINT ck_ticket_inventory_ticket_manual_code CHECK (manual_code ~ '^[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{8}$');
